name: layered-primitive-painter-v3

primitive.formula: alpha_px = min(alpha * (g(min(d2, c2)) - g(c2)) / (1 - g(c2)), max_alpha); g(t) = exp(-0.5 * t**beta); d2 = squared Mahalanobis distance; c2 = cutoff_sigma**2

attributes.name: sigma_x
attributes.note: canonical form: sigma_x >= sigma_y, theta in [0, pi)

attributes.name: color
attributes.note: k-means on continuous face decompositions plus 20% uniform prior colours

attributes.name: bend
attributes.note: LINE only: control point offset from the chord midpoint, along the normal, in units of the half length. PRIMITIVE records carry the middle bin (0).

sequence_modes.full: TEXT* BOS (LAYER_k P*)* EOS, layers strictly increasing
sequence_modes.redraw: TEXT* BOS (LAYER_j P*)* REDRAW_k P* EOS, layer k absent from the prefix
sequence_modes.refine: TEXT* BOS (LAYER_j P*)* REFINE_k P* EOS, layer k holds only its first rounds in the prefix
sequence_modes.note: compositing order is always by layer id, then by position inside the layer

condition.encoder: frozen pretrained Chinese text encoder, projected to at most max_text_positions prefix positions
condition.captions: VLM-written Chinese captions, plus CelebA-HQ 40-attribute template captions as a fallback

changes_from_v1: v1 shape codebook (1024 log-covariance codes per beta level) cost 6.6 dB on held-out faces; factorized log-sigma/theta bins cost 0.2 dB. Positions 256 -> 512 bins, beta 4 -> 8 levels, data-driven colour codebook. Full discretization: 24.9 dB (v1) -> 30.2 dB (v2) vs 32.4 dB continuous. See docs/protocol_v2.md.

attributes.theta: chord direction (period pi: a segment drawn either way is the same)
attributes.bend: control point = midpoint + bend * half_length * normal

line.formula: P0 = c - h d, P2 = c + h d, P1 = c + bend h n; coverage = clamp(w/2 - dist(pixel, curve) + 0.5, 0, 1) * alpha, w = 2 sigma_y
line.compositing: inside a layer, the layer's Gaussians first (in sequence order), then its lines (in sequence order); layers by id

changes_from_v2: LINE event (appended: ids of the v2 events unchanged)
bend attribute (appended: v2 attribute ids unchanged); PRIMITIVE records carry bend = 0, LINE records beta = 0
